title: Buzzless
style: Bouncy, light ragtime-style pizzicato and clarinet that leaves deliberate gaps so each wrong flight sound is heard clearly; a sad slow waltz for the low point; full comic brass-band finale.
key: F major -> F minor -> F major
rules: Original instrumental only. No vocals, no lyrics, no spoken word.

hit_points.cue: Silence under the honks; a single cricket chirp, then the ragtime starts on scene 2.
Piano plays a tiny embarrassed descending phrase.
Music stops for the trombone; one tuba note on the door thunk.
Slow sad waltz on solo clarinet in F minor.
Ragtime returns in short bursts between the attempts.
Tense pizzicato, then a cymbal swell on the slurp.
Music drops to a suspenseful snare roll.
Brass-band finale built from the silly wing sounds, landing on a final F major chord + honk at the cut.

end_card.cue: Music resolves on the final chord exactly at the cut; ODDLY sting plays over 2.0s end card.
